proposals: Go-to-buggery full BREAK_APART support remains unresolved: inspected rural-care quote is ambiguous between adverse fate and dismissal. Existing sense is not disproved; do not borrow go-away witnesses as ruin support.
Ta-muchly new body is individual-authored charity content, and donger has bilingual meaning evidence without Australian-use certification; stronger primary sources remain desirable.
Have-a-root gets root/sex core support, not exact have-a-root form. No automatic default/gate change proposed.
